build_CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8: build a CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8 quantization scheme with weight quantization args and optional static input scaling
create_weights_fp8_layer: create FP8 w8a8 quantized weights and scale parameters for a linear layer with specified partition sizes and block shape
process_weights_after_loading_fp8: process and transpose FP8 weights, normalize E4M3FN to E4M3FNUZ if needed, and apply aiter shuffle for HIP
apply_weights_fp8_linear: apply FP8 linear operation on input tensor with pre-quantized weights, scales, and optional bias
get_min_capability_fp8: get minimum GPU compute capability (89 for Lovelace and up) required to run FP8 w8a8 quantization kernels
